web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's official August Purchasing Managers' Indices (PMI) showed mixed results. The manufacturing PMI improved to 49.8 from 49.2 in July, slightly above the consensus forecast of 49.7. The services PMI rose to 51.4 in August from 50.4 in July, exceeding the market consensus of 50.6. The composite PMI, which includes both manufacturing and services, edged up to 49.5 from 49.3. Despite the improvements, all indices remained below the 50-point mark indicating ongoing contraction in both sectors.
